verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's own developer docs say it offers SDKs ('get started quickly with our SDKs', 'integrate Flutterwave with your platform using any of our SDKs'), so official SDKs exist. However, the evidence gives no detail on which languages are covered, how they are maintained, or how deep their API coverage is. missing for 10: list of supported SDK languages/platforms, SDK reference docs or repositories, evidence of API coverage and maintenance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You can get started quickly with our SDKs and prebuilt UIs or build fully custom solutions using our APIs.
Easily integrate Flutterwave with your platform using any of our SDKs.
